Commit: 5578945964760be0bf234c506fdbcbcfe07c974d
Copied from upstream: src/client/frontend/gui, src/client/frontend/frontend-common, src/client/client-common, LICENSE.
Gozar modifications in src/client/frontend/gui/connectwindow:
- locationsmenu.cpp and locationsmenu.h optionally restrict tabs to all/search
  before state changes and persisted-tab restoration.
- connectwindowitem.cpp and connectwindowitem.h optionally hide and disable the
  upstream protocol/firewall displays, whose semantics differ from Gozar, and
  expose an opt-in method to enable only supported shell navigation controls.
Gozar FontManager also verifies registration and adds the Gozar Vazirmatn Arabic-script fallback.
Default upstream connect-window behavior remains when these optional restrictions are not requested.
Development snapshot only; not a release.

Gozar-specific opt-in presentation also allows the existing Favourites tab,
filters unsupported original preference tabs, hosts the stock native tray
locations menu, suppresses unavailable latency/IP details in the existing
city delegates, and displays real Gozar core telemetry in ConnectWindowItem.
